title: Quantum Threat Escalates
script_summary:
**QUANTUM THREAT? BITCOIN'S JUST GETTING STRONGER.**

The network's hitting record hashrate—two-fifty exahashes—while quantum fears dominate the chatter. That's the real signal: Bitcoin's adoption conquest is outpacing any computational threat.

Here's what matters. Price held seventy-two thousand on geopolitical demand. Long-term holders now control eighty percent of supply—that's conviction, not panic. The quantum vulnerability narrative is noise.
